text: It is set up for the students who wish to study Chinese language exclusively. Chinese language classes are divided into three administrative levels in accordance with students' proficiency of Chinese, namely: Elementary, Intermediate and Advanced Classes. There will be an entrance exam, according which to divide into classes. The lectures are conducted in a highly professional manner and at the same time, the extra curricula activities range from school visits to cultural and language interactions. These are designed to deepen the students' understanding of the Chinese culture, train their skills of practicing Chinese and create a sound base for their further study and future progression. After completing the course, students qualify for a certificate in Chinese proficiency. Placement Test: March 1 Time to Buy Teaching Materials: March 2
